# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v1 c18 P25](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0025), [v3 c1 P17](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0017), [v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes and hair, rosy cheeks, and dimples. She possesses a merry expression inherited from her father, along with notable snap and color in her looks.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Diana is good, smart, and cheerful. She is a dedicated reader who frequently pores over books, though she can get easily scared or nervous in difficult situations.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)_

## Traits

- fond of reading  <sub>[v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022)</sub>
- easily frightened in emergencies  <sub>[v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- making fashionable tissue paper bookmarkers  <sub>[v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)</sub>

## History

Diana Barry lived at Orchard Slope and met Anne Shirley as a child, swearing an oath of lifelong friendship with her in the garden. When her younger sister Minnie May fell severely ill with croup while their parents were away, Diana ran to get Anne's help. She joined the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and served as its treasurer. As she grew older, she was courted by Fred Wright, and they eventually married in a ceremony followed by feasting before driving away to their new home together.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v3 c29 P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013)_
